name: Calendar and daily notes
description: Browse daily notes and separate calendars for ordinary notes created or last updated.

dailyFolder.title: Daily-note folder
dailyFolder.description: Vault-relative folder, created only when you create a daily note. Leave empty for the vault root.

filenameFormat.title: Filename format
filenameFormat.description: Include YYYY, MM, and DD exactly once. Use -, _, . or spaces as separators and [brackets] for literal text. Omit .md.

dateMetadata.title: Include date metadata
dateMetadata.description: Show other Markdown notes with a top-level date: YYYY-MM-DD in YAML frontmatter. Daily filenames take precedence.
